comments.headline: Horizontal Sky-to-Ground Clearance Dimensions Missing

comments.attn: Applies across multiple site features (buildings, projections, fences, walkways, lighting, utilities). Surveyed conductor locations required to establish baseline for dimensional verification.

comments.headline: Building Elevation Sheets & Surveyed Conductor Data Missing

comments.crossDep: Surveying firm must provide surveyed conductor locations and mid-span elevation data; coordination with electrical utility required.
comments.attn: Critical documentation gap. Surveyed elevation data from registered surveyor is explicitly required by UCM § 1.10.3 when vertical clearances may not meet minimums. This blocks clearance verification for multiple site features.

comments.headline: No Clearance Dimensions From Outer Conductor on Any Plan Sheet
comments.summary: The site plan shows overhead electric facilities but provides zero clearance dimension annotations on any sheet. This is a fundamental documentation failure: dimensions must originate from the outside conductor, not pole centerline, per code.
comments.crossDep: All utility clearance work must involve electrical utility coordination and surveying.
comments.attn: Critical administrative and technical deficiency. When dimensions are provided, they must be measured from the outside conductor, not pole centerline. On three-phase installations, the conductor may be several feet offset from pole center. No dimensions currently exist anywhere on the plans.

details.text: The site plan shows overhead electric facilities but provides NO clearance dimensions on any sheet. Where clearances must be annotated from the outside conductor to building edges, driveways, or other site features per UCM § 1.10.3, NO DIMENSIONS are provided. This is a fundamental documentation failure preventing any clearance verification.

runComments.comment: The site plan shows overhead electric facilities but provides NO clearance dimensions at all on any sheet. Where clearances should be annotated from the outside conductor to building edges, driveways, or other site features per UCM § 1.10.3 and the grouping guidance (dimensions must originate from outer conductor, not pole centerline), NO DIMENSIONS are provided. This is a fundamental documentation failure preventing any clearance verification.

Overhead electric lines and utility poles are shown on the site plan, but NO clearance dimensions are annotated on any sheets (site plan, grading plan, or other exhibits).
